condition: Steroid-refractory ulcerative colitis with CMV colitis
summary: 45-year-old man on azathioprine and infliximab, day 5 of IV steroids without response; flexible sigmoidoscopy biopsies show CMV inclusions on immunohistochemistry. ECCO 2021: antiviral therapy (IV ganciclovir) for steroid-refractory colitis with CMV; colectomy discussion if no response.

inputs.chiefComplaint: Bloody diarrhoea not settling in hospital
inputs.hpi: Extensive UC on azathioprine and infliximab (loss of response). Day 5 of IV hydrocortisone: still 9 bloody stools a day, fevers to 38.2. C. difficile negative. Flexible sigmoidoscopy: deep ulcers; biopsies show CMV inclusion bodies on immunohistochemistry.

exam.abdomen: Soft, tender over the colon, not distended.

labs.name: Colonic biopsy CMV IHC
labs.resultText: CMV immunohistochemistry positive, several inclusions per fragment

imaging.name: Flexible sigmoidoscopy
imaging.result: Severe colitis with deep punched-out ulcers to 35 cm. Biopsies taken.

confirmedDiagnosis.name: Steroid-refractory acute severe ulcerative colitis with CMV colitis
confirmedDiagnosis.assessmentText: Steroid-refractory acute severe ulcerative colitis with CMV colitis on biopsy (immunohistochemistry positive), on azathioprine and infliximab. Antiviral therapy; colectomy discussion.

mustInclude.note: CMV must be looked for (biopsy immunohistochemistry/PCR) in steroid-refractory colitis before further immunosuppression.
mustInclude.proposedFix: Read biopsy/IHC results for CMV in UC; steroid-refractory UC → CMV testing prompt (ECCO 2021).

mustInclude.note: ECCO 2021: antiviral therapy for CMV colitis in steroid-refractory UC with high-density CMV on biopsy.
mustInclude.proposedFix: Add a CMV-colitis branch: CMV on biopsy in steroid-refractory UC → IV ganciclovir, review immunomodulators (ECCO 2021).

guideline.name: ECCO guidelines — prevention, diagnosis and management of infections in IBD
guideline.section: CMV: test tissue (IHC/PCR) in steroid-refractory colitis; antiviral therapy (ganciclovir) when CMV colitis is present; review immunomodulators
guideline.citation: Kucharzik T, Ellul P, Greuter T, et al. ECCO guidelines on the prevention, diagnosis, and management of infections in inflammatory bowel disease. J Crohns Colitis. 2021;15:879–913.

guideline.name: ECCO guidelines on therapeutics in ulcerative colitis — surgical treatment
guideline.citation: Spinelli A, Bonovas S, Burisch J, et al. ECCO guidelines on therapeutics in ulcerative colitis: surgical treatment. J Crohns Colitis. 2022;16:179–189.

rationale: Permutation: immunosuppression (thiopurine + anti-TNF) and an opportunistic infection. Tests whether the CMV biopsy result changes the plan.
